data: What is the value of the red line at a beam size of 30?

The red line represents the BLEU score. The x-axis shows the beam size, ranging from 0 to 50. The y-axis shows the BLEU score, ranging from 23.0 to 24.2. At a beam size of 30, the red line appears to be slightly above 24.0. Therefore, the value of the red line at a beam size of 30 is approximately 24.0.
